Had to turn my viral baked lasagne jacket into a tray bake for four … because one potato simply isn’t enough when comfort food calls 🥔😂 This is a take on my baked lasagne style jacket potato just bigger, better, and perfect for feeding four instead of one. Fluffy crispy jackets. Rich leftover Bolognese. Creamy cheesy béchamel. Finished with a golden cheese melt. Would you share this… or keep the whole tray to yourself? 👀 🥔 Lasagne-Style Jacket Potato Tray Bake Serves 4 Ingredients Jackets • 4 large baking potatoes • Olive oil spray • Sea salt & black pepper • 40g butter Filling • 600–700g leftover Bolognese sauce Cheesy Béchamel Sauce • 40g butter • 40g plain flour • 500ml semi-skimmed milk • Black pepper • 100g mixed grated cheese • 30–40g grated Parmesan For layering • 150–200g mozzarella or mixed cheese • Extra Parmesan for topping Method 1. Cook the jacket potatoes Pierce potatoes, rub with olive oil and salt. Air fry at 180°C for 45 minutes, then another 10 minutes until crispy. Oven option: 200°C for about 1 hour until fluffy inside and crunchy outside. 2. Make the cheesy béchamel Melt butter in a pan over medium heat. Stir in flour and cook for 1 minute. Gradually whisk in the milk until smooth and thickened. Season with black pepper, then stir through mixed cheese and Parmesan until melted and creamy. Set aside. 3. Assemble the tray bake Place all 4 crispy jackets into a large tray. Slice open and gently mash the centres with butter, salt and pepper. 👉 Spoon 1 tablespoon of béchamel into each potato and mix through the fluffy middle. Now layer in this order: • Add the leftover Bolognese • Pour over more béchamel sauce • Sprinkle over mozzarella or mixed cheese • Finish with a generous grating of Parmesan 4. Final melt Bake at 180°C for 10–12 minutes or air fry at 180°C for 4–5 minutes until golden, bubbling and irresistible. #foryoupagе #spud #jacketpotato #jacketpotatoes #lasagna

videos.caption: This is seriously one of the best appetizers I’ve ever made, and easy to throw together! 🤤 roasted tomato burrata dip with garlic bread crostinis!) 🍅🧄 Ripe bursted cherry tomatoes, stir in burrata, and scoop it all up with crispy garlic crostinis. A total flavor bomb… have the recipe ready, people WILL ask for it! 🛒You’ll Need: • cherry tomatoes • Olive oil • Salt, pepper, red pepper flakes • Garlic, parsley, oregano • Burrata • Fresh basil • Parmesan • French baguette • Butter, garlic, salt, parm (for garlic butter) 🧈 How to Make: 	1.	Add grape tomatoes to a baking dish and drizzle generously with olive oil (about halfway up). 	2.	Season with salt, pepper, red pepper flakes, garlic, parsley, and oregano. 	3.	Bake at 425°F for 20-30 mins until tomatoes burst (you can gently smash them halfway if they need some assistance in the ‘bursting’ process). 	4.	While that bakes, slice baguette, spread with garlic butter (butter, garlic, salt, parm), and toast 5–7 mins until golden. 	5.	Once you’re ready to serve, top with parm, fresh basil, and burrata. Stir it all together and serve HOT. Dip. Scoop. Repeat. Bala baiana! These are Brazilian coconut bob bons! My friend @KITCHENTOOL thanks for the recipe! I searched so many recipes and his is the easiest to follow in my opinion! Check his page out! Ingredients: 1 tbsp salted butter 1 can (14oz)sweetened condensed milk  2/3 cup sweetened coconut flakes  Sugar coating: 1 cup granulated sugar 1/2 cup water 1 tbsp vinegar  How to: In a sauce pan add butter and turn it on medium heat until melted. Next add in sweetened condensed milk and coconut flakes. Stir on medium heat for 5-7 minutes until the mixture is thickened and can pull away from the pan. Add it into a separate bowl and place in the refrigerator until cooled.  Once cooled, take a tbsp of the mixture and roll it between greased hands to form a ball and place it onto a parchment lined pan until all of the mixture is formed into bite sized balls. Next in a sauce, pan, combine sugar, water, and vinegar. Bring to a boil, stirring occasionally, until it turns amber in color. Take off the heat. Next insert a toothpick into each ball and dip it into the amber sugar and place back onto a parchment lined pan.  Let cool and serve! #dessert #coconut #balabaiana #easyrecipe #recipeshare

Creamy Pesto Chicken Pasta Bake ✨ My most viral recipe of 2024!  What a year it’s been. I’m truly so grateful for all the love and support you’ve shown me this year. Cheers to a delicious 2025!  Here’s how to make it: 1lb pasta of choice 1/2 cup sun-dried tomatoes + oil 1lb chicken 1 tbsp butter 1/2 yellow onion, diced Salt and pepper, to taste 1 tsp red pepper flakes (to taste) 1 tsp smoked paprika (to taste) 1 tsp oregano (to taste) 6-8 cloves of garlic, minced (to taste) 2 cups heavy cream (room temp) 1-2 cups cooked broccoli  2 handfuls spinach 6-8 oz freshly shredded parmesan cheese (divided) 8 oz freshly shredded mozzarella (divided) 1/2 cup pesto, to taste (I recommend Costco brand) Parsley to garnish  1. Preheat oven to 350°F. Place the cream on the counter to come to room temp. 2. Boil your noodles in salted water a few minutes less than package instructions (al dente). Drain and set aside.  3. In a large oven-safe saucepan or dutch oven, heat 1 tbsp of sun-dried tomato oil over medium heat. Cook the chicken until it's no longer pink, then remove it from the pan and set it aside. Let it rest for a few minutes before cutting into bite-sized pieces. 4. In the same pan, melt the butter and add salt, pepper, red pepper, paprika, and oregano. Stir to toast, then toss in the onion and sauté for about 4 minutes. Add the garlic and cook for another 30 seconds. 5. Turn heat to low, pour in the heavy cream and stir. Let it simmer for a couple of minutes to thicken slightly. 6. Add half of the parmesan and 1 cup of mozzarella cheese,  stir until the cheese is melted. 7. Stir in the sun-dried tomatoes, cooked broccoli, spinach, chicken, cooked pasta, and pesto. 8. Top with the remaining mozzarella and parmesan cheese.  9. Bake at 350°F for 15 minutes, then broil for another 5 minutes, or until the top is golden and bubbly. 10. Sprinkle with fresh parsley, a little more parmesan, and enjoy! #pastabake #chickenpesto #pesto #pestopasta #pestochicken #pasta #pastarecipe #easyrecipe #easyrecipes #easymeal #easydinner #dinnerideas #dinner #foodtok #cooking

Blanket Dumplings 🥟 These dumplings definitely live up to the hype. They’re by far the quickest and easiest way to make homemade dumplings, and you can have them on the table in under 25 minutes. If you’re always looking for new dinner ideas, you’re in the right place. That’s why I share simple and affordable meals that save you time and money. Follow for more Weeknight Staples. Ingredients • 1 lb ground pork • 1/3 cup green onions, thinly sliced • 1 tbsp fresh ginger, grated • 4 garlic cloves, minced • 1 tbsp oyster sauce • 1 tsp black pepper • 2 tbsp chili crisp • 3 tbsp soy sauce • 1½ tsp sesame oil • 1 tbsp rice vinegar • 18–20 dumpling wrappers • 1/4 cup chicken broth • Avocado oil For Topping • Soy sauce • Chili crisp • Green onions • Sesame seeds Instructions 1. In a bowl, combine the ground pork, green onions, grated ginger, garlic, oyster sauce, black pepper, chili crisp, soy sauce, sesame oil, and rice vinegar. Mix until fully combined. 2. Use a cookie scoop to place mounds of the filling onto a sheet pan, leaving enough space between each one. 3. Place a dumpling wrapper over each mound and pinch the edges around the filling to seal. 4. Drizzle with avocado oil, pour in the chicken broth, cover, and steam for 10 minutes, or until the pork reaches an internal temperature of 160°F. 5. Top with soy sauce, chili crisp, green onions, and sesame seeds before serving with a side of rice. #easydinners #dumpling #blanketdumplings

Viralowe pierożki z patelni – chrupiące od spodu i obłędnie soczyste w środku! Jeśli lubisz azjatyckie smaki, koniecznie zapisz ten przepis. Z podanych składników przygotujesz 2 duże porcje. SKŁADNIKI: 20 płatów ciasta do pierożków dim sum 500 g mielonej wieprzowiny 1 marchewka duża garść szczypiorku 6 ząbków czosnku 1 łyżka startego imbiru 2 łyżki sosu sojowego 2 łyżki sosu ostrygowego 1 łyżka oleju sezamowego 1 łyżeczka cukru trzcinowego 1 łyżeczka soli 125 ml bulionu warzywnego PRZYGOTOWANIE: 1. Marchewkę zetrzyj, szczypiorek drobno posiekaj, a czosnek przeciśnij przez praskę. 2. Do mielonej wieprzowiny dodaj marchewkę, szczypiorek, czosnek i starty imbir. 3. Dodaj sos sojowy, sos ostrygowy, olej sezamowy, cukier trzcinowy i sól. Całość dokładnie wymieszaj. 4. Porcję farszu nakładaj na środek ciasta do dim sum i dokładnie zlepiaj pierożki. 5. Pierożki ułóż na patelni i podsmażaj na średnim ogniu przez około 2 minuty, aż spód zacznie się rumienić. 6. Wlej 125 ml bulionu warzywnego, przykryj patelnię i gotuj przez około 16 minut. 7. Zdejmij pokrywkę i gotowe! Najlepiej smakują polane olejem chili lub dodatkowym sosem sojowym. WARTOŚCI ODŻYWCZE NA 1 PORCJĘ: 825 kcal 62 g białka 39 g tłuszczu 57 g węglowodanów 4 g błonnika Chrupiący spód, miękkie ciasto i aromatyczny, soczysty farsz. The high-protein, low-carb dinner I wish I knew about sooner… and best part, it only takes 15 minutes!! #RECIPE Enoki Beef Rolls 🍄 Ingredients (3-4 servings): 1 lb thinly sliced beef (I used “shabu shabu beef”) 7 oz enoki mushrooms 1 white onion, thinly sliced 1 tbsp oil (avocado oil preferred) 2 eggs, whisked Garnish: chopped green onions, sesame seeds Sauce: 1/3 cup water 1/4 cup soy sauce 1 tbsp sesame oil 1 garlic clove, minced Dash of pepper 🥩 Instructions: Prep the mushrooms – Trim the bottom 1-2 inches off the enoki mushrooms, rinse, and separate into small bundles. Roll it up – Lay out a slice of beef and roll each enoki bundle tightly inside. Repeat until all are wrapped. Make the sauce – Mix all sauce ingredients in a bowl and set aside. Sauté the onions – Heat oil in a large skillet over med-high heat, add onions, and cook for 3min until softened. Cook the rolls – Place the beef rolls over the onions in a single layer, pour in the sauce, cover, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low-med and simmer for 3min (until beef is cooked through). Add the eggs – Uncover, pour whisked eggs over the rolls, cover again, and cook for 1min.  Finish & serve – Salt to taste. Remove from heat, garnish with green onions and sesame seeds. Enjoy! #creatorsearchinsights

Jam & Buttered Toast Cookies 🍓🍞🍪 Crispy toast edges, gooey white choc, ripples of raspberry jam 😮‍💨 the snapshot recipe is below & the full version is on my Substack.  The inevitable evolution of the toast cookie. Arguably even more intriguing than the first one? Very after-school-snack vibes. I dive into this recipe with full detail & have a little chat about this past week going viral over on Substack.  Ingredients ✨ 🍞 Toast flakes: • 3 slices sourdough, toasted - I used @jasonssourdough  • ~1 tbsp salted butter • ~1 tbsp raspberry conserve (I bought the @marksandspencerfood one). *MAKE SURE* it’s not too watery, you want a firm jam/conserve. The one with fruit pieces is even better as less spread!  🍪 Cookie dough: • 50g cold unsalted butter + 80g brown butter • 1 tsp white miso • 165g white sugar + 60g dark brown/muscovado • 1 egg + 1 yolk • 1 tsp vanilla • 250g plain flour • ½ tsp bicarb, ¼ tsp baking powder, ¼ tsp salt • 240g white chocolate (save some for topping 🤍) • 120g raspberry conserve (for swirling 🍓) How 🌀 Toast, butter & jam the bread → blitz into flakes 🍞 Cold butter + Brown butter → mix with sugars + miso → add egg, yolk & vanilla Fold in dry → add white choc + 60g toast flakes Spoon jam over dough to marble (DON’T MIX ❗️) Scoop, coat in toast flakes, chill ❄️ Bake at 190°C for 9–11 mins 🔥 Top with extra white choc, cool slightly & enjoy 🤍

Viral Chocolate box cake✨🍫🍰 #yellowboxcake #bettycrocker #yellowcakechocolatefrosting #boxcake #dessert Ingredients: • 1 box Betty Crocker Yellow Cake Mix or Butter Recipe Yellow Cake mix  • 4 eggs • 1 stick unsalted butter, melted • 1 cup buttermilk or milk • 1 tsp vanilla extract • 1 container Betty Crocker Hershey’s Chocolate Frosting Instructions: 1. In a large bowl, combine the Betty Crocker Yellow Cake Mix, 4 eggs, melted butter, milk, and vanilla extract. 2. Mix until smooth and well combined. 3. Pour the batter into a greased 9x11 baking pan. 4. Bake at 315°F for 37 minutes. 5. Let the cake cool completely. 6. Microwave the Betty Crocker Hershey’s Chocolate Frosting for 15–20 seconds until pourable (warm, not hot). 7. Pour the frosting over the cake, making sure to cover all the corners evenly. 8. Let the frosting set for 1–2 hours. 9. Slice, serve, and enjoy!

 all of the recipe deets are below 💕  ingredients: * 2 tbsp olive or avocado oil * 1 lb boneless chicken thighs * 1 + 1/2 tsp salt * 1/2 tsp black pepper * 2 tsp smoked paprika * 2 tsp italian seasoning * 1/4 yellow onion, chopped * 3 garlic cloves, minced * 1 cup of white rice * 1 lemon, juiced * 1 cup chicken broth * 1/2 of 15oz can full-fat coconut milk * 2 cups chopped kale * up to 1 + 1/2 cups water, as needed * 1/3 cup fresh chopped parsley instructions:  1. preheat oven to 375 degrees and drizzle the olive oil on a large skillet over medium heat on the stovetop. 2. pat the chicken thighs dry with a paper towel, then season all over with the salt, black pepper, smoked paprika, and italian seasoning. transfer the chicken to the pan when the olive oil is heated. 3. cook the chicken to crisp each side, about 5-7 minutes on each side depending on thickness, then set aside on a plate. in the same pan, add the chopped onion and sauté for 5 minutes, then add the minced garlic. 4. when the onion and garlic are translucent, pour in the rice and let it toast for a few minutes, stirring frequently. add in the lemon juice, chicken broth, and coconut milk and mix to combine. 5. add in all of the chopped kale and let it wilt down. add up to 1 + 1/2 cups of water as needed to wilt down the kale and make sure all of the rice is covered in liquid. transfer to the oven and bake for 15-20 minutes, until the rice is fully cooked and the chicken has an internal temp of 165 degrees. 6. serve immediately or store the chicken and rice in airtight containers in the fridge for up to 4 days. #budgetshopping #groceriesonabudget #groceryshopping #groceryhaul #mealprep #mealprepping #mealprepideas #grocerylist #mealsonabudget #healthyonabudget #easyhealthyrecipes #glutenfreerecipes #dairyfreerecipes #onepotmeal

Viral Pepperoni Pizza Caesar Wrap Recipe 🍕 made this wrap for dinner and my family enjoy it! It’s like having a pizza and a Caesar salad together but without the carbs☺️ Makes 2 wraps Ingredients For the Cheese Wraps * 1½ cups freshly grated part-skim low-moisture mozzarella cheese * 14–16 pepperoni slices * sprinkle with oregano and red pepper flakes For the Caesar Salad * 1 head romaine lettuce * ¼ cup crushed croutons * Extra parmesan cheese, for topping For the Caesar Dressing * ¼ cup Best Foods mayonnaise * ¼ cup 0% Greek yogurt * Juice from ½ lemon * 2 tsp Worcestershire sauce * 1½ tsp Dijon mustard * 1 large garlic clove, grated * ¼ cup grated parmesan cheese * ¼–½ tsp black pepper Directions 1. Preheat oven to 375°F. 2. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Spread ¾ cup freshly grated part-skim low-moisture mozzarella into a thin tortilla-sized circle. Top each with 7–8 pepperoni slices and sprinkle with the oregano and red pepper flakes. 3. Bake for 10-12 minutes or until crispy around the edges and golden brown. 4. Slice the romaine lettuce lengthwise, chop into thin strips, rinse under cold water, and dry very well using a salad spinner. 5. In a bowl, mix together the mayonnaise, Greek yogurt, lemon juice, Worcestershire sauce, Dijon mustard, garlic, parmesan, and black pepper. 6. Toss the romaine with most of the dressing, crushed croutons, and parmesan cheese. 7. Let the wraps cool slightly, then fill with the Caesar salad. Top with extra parmesan, croutons, and dressing if desired. #dinnerideas #easydinners #caesarsalad #pizza #wrap

👀🍫FUDGY BROWNIE CHEESECAKE BARS…  No baking required. Makes 7 BIG bars, each with: 240 cals, 10g protein, 10 net carbs Here is another viral recipe that absolutely holds up to the hype. You’ve got a rich brownie base, a creamy cheesecake center, and a chocolate layer right on top. These are a little more dense than your traditional brownie cheesecake bar, but made with better-for-you ingredients, incredibly satisfying, and SO GOOD. Big thanks to @nora.dora99 for this amazing recipe! Here’s how to make them: FOR THE BROWNIE BASE: 150g almond flour 30g unsweetened cocoa powder 2 tbsp calorie-free sugar-free maple syrup 1 tbsp melted coconut oil 3 tbsp unsweetened almond milk Splash of vanilla extract Mix everything together until you have a brownie batter. Press it firmly into a parchment-lined loaf pan or small baking dish and freeze for 10 mins. FOR THE CHEESECAKE LAYER: 250g fat-free cream cheese (regular works too!) 10g sweetener of choice Splash of vanilla extract Squeeze of lemon juice I processed this in a food processor, but you can also use a hand mixer. Then spread it over the brownie base and freeze for about 45 mins. FOR THE CHOCOLATE TOPPING: 40g unsweetened cocoa powder 2 tbsp calorie-free sugar-free maple syrup 1 tbsp melted coconut oil 2 tbsp unsweetened almond milk Mix until smooth, spread it over the cheesecake layer, and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to set. I cut these into 7 bars, but you can cut them into whatever size bars you like to manage your own goals. My take on the viral beef kebab roll ups 😮‍💨🔥  What You’ll Need: For the Beef 	•	1 lb ground beef (80/20 works best) 	•	1 tbsp olive oil 	•	¼–½ cup finely diced onion 	•	¼–½ cup finely diced bell pepper 	•	Small handful fresh parsley, finely chopped 	•	2 garlic cloves, minced 	•	1 tsp curry powder 	•	1 tsp beef bouillon 	•	1 tsp garlic powder 	•	1 tsp onion powder 	•	1 tsp black pepper 	•	2 tsp paprika 	•	½ tsp cumin 	•	Salt to taste For Assembly 	•	Lavash bread or large flour tortillas 	•	Wooden skewers, soaked in water For the Chili Butter 	•	2 tbsp butter 	•	1 tbsp olive oil 	•	1 tsp tomato paste 	•	3 tsp paprika 	•	Salt to taste 	•	Optional: pinch of chili flakes for heat For Serving 	•	Plain yogurt or garlic yogurt 	•	Fresh parsley 	•	Lemon wedges How To Make Them Mix together the ground beef, onion, bell pepper, garlic, parsley, olive oil, and seasonings until smooth and slightly sticky. Cover and refrigerate for 20–30 minutes while soaking your skewers in water. Spread a thin layer of the beef mixture onto lavash bread or tortillas, roll tightly, then slice into pieces. Thread onto skewers, packing them closely together. Bake at 400°F for 20–25 minutes, flipping halfway through, until golden and cooked through. For the chili butter, melt together the butter and olive oil, then stir in the tomato paste, paprika, salt, and chili flakes if using. Let it cook for 30 seconds until glossy and fragrant. Brush the skewers generously with the chili butter, then broil for 1–2 minutes until lightly charred and crispy around the edges. Serve over garlic yogurt or alongside fries, then finish with fresh parsley and a squeeze of lemon. #cookwithme #kurveyskitchen #easymeals #viralfood #kebab

Would you make this?! I can’t wait to make it again! 🍁Fall Dinner Club, episode 3🍁featuring the VIRAL Chicken Au Poivre. Shoutout to @Corre Larkin for introducing me to this one! I’ve written out exactly how I made it below⬇️⬇️⬇️ and there’s a recipe card at the end for you.  Chicken Au Poivre Ingredients 1 whole chicken 1 tablespoon olive oil Salt and black pepper, to taste 2 teaspoons each garlic powder and onion powder For the sauce 1 shallot, finely diced 4 garlic cloves, minced 1–2 tablespoons fresh rosemary, chopped About 1 teaspoon salt, or to taste About 1 Tbs. coarsely crushed black peppercorns 3 cups heavy cream, plus more to thin the sauce if needed 3 Tbs. cup sherry cooking wine Fresh chopped parsley, for garnish Directions Preheat your oven to 375°F. Using kitchen shears, cut through the breast side of the chicken and open it flat. Remove any giblets from the cavity, then pat the chicken dry. Drizzle with olive oil and season inside and out with salt, pepper, garlic powder, and onion powder. Place breast-side up in a roasting pan and roast for 15–20 minutes. Meanwhile, combine the shallot, garlic, rosemary, salt, crushed peppercorns, and heavy cream in a bowl. Remove the chicken from the oven and increase the temperature to 400°F. Pour the sherry cooking wine directly into the roasting pan around the chicken, then pour the cream mixture over the chicken. Return to the oven and roast for another 40–50 minutes, basting twice with the pan sauce. Cooking time will vary depending on the size of your chicken. Once the thickest part of the breast and the innermost thigh reach 165°F, remove the chicken from the oven and let it rest before carving. If needed, stir a few extra tablespoons of heavy cream into the pan sauce to thin it. Serve over mashed potatoes with plenty of extra sauce and a sprinkle of fresh parsley. Enjoy! #falldinner #chickenrecipe #dinnerrecipes #sundaydinner #chickenaupoivre

Hot Honey Chipotle Chicken Tostadas🍯🍗🔥 #foodtok #easyrecipes #foodreview #recipehack #weeknightmeals  Recipe:  For the Chicken: * 2–3 chicken breasts, diced into small pieces * 2 tbsp mayonnaise * 1–2 chipotle peppers in adobo sauce, minced * 1 tbsp adobo sauce * Avocado oil * Garlic powder * Cumin * Paprika * Chipotle seasoning * Salt & pepper to taste * Juice of 1 lime * Honey or hot honey, to taste For the Guacamole: * 2–3 avocados * Diced Roma tomato * Diced red onion * Salt & pepper to taste * Juice of 1 lime * Chopped cilantro For the Pico de Gallo: * Diced Roma tomatoes * Diced red onion * Chopped cilantro * Salt & pepper to taste * Juice of ½ lime For the Chipotle Sauce: * Mayonnaise * 1–2 chipotle peppers in adobo sauce * Paprika * 1–2 garlic cloves, minced * Salt & pepper to taste * Juice of ½ lime For Serving: * Tostada shells Instructions 1. Start by dicing your chicken breasts into small bite-sized pieces. Add to a bowl with mayonnaise, minced chipotle peppers, adobo sauce, avocado oil, garlic powder, cumin, paprika, chipotle seasoning, salt, pepper, and the juice of one lime. Mix well until everything is coated. Cover and marinate for at least 1 hour, or longer for even more flavor. 2. While your chicken marinates, prepare your guacamole. Add your avocados, diced Roma tomato, red onion, salt, pepper, lime juice, and cilantro to a bowl. Mash everything together until you reach your desired consistency. 3. For the pico de gallo, combine diced tomatoes, red onion, cilantro, salt, pepper, and the juice of ½ lime. Mix well and set aside. 4. Next, make your chipotle sauce. In a bowl, combine mayonnaise, chipotle peppers in adobo sauce, paprika, minced garlic, salt, pepper, and lime juice. Mix until smooth and creamy. 5. Heat a drizzle of avocado oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Add your marinated chicken and sear until golden brown and fully cooked. 6. Drizzle your chicken with honey or hot honey, depending on how much heat you like. Reduce the heat to a simmer and toss until the honey slightly thickens and coats the chicken. This usually takes about 1 minute. 7. To assemble, spread a generous layer of guacamole over your tostada shells, add your fresh pico de gallo, pile on that hot honey chicken, and finish with a drizzle of your homemade chipotle sauce.
